newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates end high, central bank active.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates end high, central bank active.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates ended at high levels on Wednesday amid a shortage of liquidity and an open market operation by the central bank, dealers said.
They said rates might continue to hover at similar levels on Thursday as the market closed short.
Most trade in overnight funds throughout the day was seen at 20 percent, one dealer said.
Two-month bids were quoted at 15.50 percent and three-month bids at 15.25 percent, but lenders were offering two-month funds at 16.25 percent and and three-month at 16.50 percent.
